rationale.conceptual: The method combines standard DFT relaxation, non‑SCF calculations, and Boltzmann transport within the rigid‑band/constant‑relaxation‑time approximations. This forms a multi‑stage workflow with dependency on multiple external packages and non‑trivial I/O, typical of a fragile computational science reproduction.
